newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ICB Shipping says unit plans issue, Nasdaq listing.
newsitem.headline: ICB Shipping says unit plans issue, Nasdaq listing.

text.p: Swedish shipping company ICB Shipping said on Monday its subsidiary Knightsbridge Tankers Ltd of Bermuda planned a new $300 million share issue of 15 million shares at $20 a share.
It also said in a statement it had applied to list the shares on the NASDAQ stock exchange.

Knightsbridge Tankers said the proceeds of the offering together with $184 million credit proceeds from an international syndicate of lenders and the proceeds of a finance lease arrangement would be used to build five very large crude carrier oil tankers (VLCCs).
"The VLCCs will be chartered on a "hell and high water" basis to Shell International Petroleum Co Ltd, a company of the Royal Dutch/Shell Group for a minimum seven year term," the statement said.
Shell International would also have the option to extend the period for each VLCC for an additional seven years to a maximum of 14 years per VLCC.
The managing underwriters for the offering are Goldman Sachs & Co and Lazard Freres & Co LLC.
The offering is expected to start in January.
The company said a registration statement relating to the issue has been filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission but has not yet become effective.
